Alex / Procurement team —

Congrats again on the signature — excited to get Meridian onboarded. Attached is our working activation playbook (MAP) that we discussed during the close: it embeds the canary windows, migration steps, and training timeline so everyone has a single source of truth. High-level asks from our side: 

- Please confirm target canary window (we suggested Nov 18–19).
- Confirm the list of production pilot tenants (you mentioned three clinics in the demo).
- Approve training slots (we proposed Nov 15 and Nov 17, 2-hour sessions).

What’s included in the attached workbook:
- Sheet A: Mutual Action Plan (owners, acceptance criteria, sign-offs)
- Sheet B: Canary test cases and rollback criteria
- Sheet C: Training roster and prerequisites

I've also shared a live copy on Drive so we can iterate: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c

Attachment: Meridian_Activation_Playbook_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

If you prefer, we can convert the MAP into a DocuSign-friendly sign-off after we lock dates.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,

Thanks — quick technical readout and confirmation from infra: 

- Canary feasibility: Confirmed. We can run the pilot on a reserved dedicated pool (2 x A100 equiv) with traffic shaping to the three pilot clinics. Expected token throughput margin ~2.5x above demo load.
- Rollback criteria (abbreviated): 
  - >10% error rate increase for 5m rolling window -> immediate rollback to pre-canary model variant.
  - Latency tail >500ms p95 for 3 consecutive 1m intervals -> pause canary and triage.
- Migration steps (high-level): pre-sync KV cache -> run canary on subset -> validate output quality (eval set) -> promote -> scale gradually. Detailed step-by-step will go into the runbook.
- Audit logs and retention: we'll provide an S3 export of structured audit logs with 90-day hot retention + 2yr cold archive; will include export cadence and sample schema for procurement.

Attached is a short runbook snippet for procurement to review. Also flagged a small dependency: we need ACL access to Meridian's pilot tenant list (Lila to provide).

Attachment: Prod_Runbook_snippet.txt (txt)

I'll update the MAP workbook with the acceptance criteria and the rollback matrix and push the final version to Drive by EOD Nov 5.

— Dev
